--- access checks ---
a superuser may select from any table
a superuser is not limited by the access table
a reader may select from the table granted to its group
a reader may not select from an ungranted table
a bare variable reference is allowed when read access is granted
a bare variable reference is refused without read access
read access does not imply write access
an unknown user is refused
--- group hierarchy: a group may contain a group ---
carol is in seniors which is in readers
access is inherited through the group chain
--- virtual tables ---
vtrade is trade with an enforced where clause
a granted virtual table is readable
the enforced where clause subsets the real table
a correct md5 password authenticates
an incorrect password is refused
an unknown user is refused
an empty password is refused when public users are off
--- maxsize ---
re-init with a tiny maxsize
a result over maxsize is refused

re-init in permissive mode
